description: This file provides configuration helpers for authentication, including environment variable parsing, validation, and tenant resolution logic. It exports functions to retrieve secrets, salts, and tenant configuration details.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable values by converting undefined or null to empty string and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Validates if a string is URL-safe base64 without padding, typically 20-44 characters long, and contains only URL-safe characters.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the tenant salt from environment variables, normalizing and checking its format.

methods.name: getJwtSecretConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT secret from environment variables, indicating if it is missing or weak.

methods.name: getPasswordSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the password salt from environment variables, indicating if it is missing or a placeholder.

methods.name: tenantFromHost
methods.description: Extracts the tenant identifier from a host header by taking the left-most label.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant resolution and allowlist/mapping validation based on environment variables and request data.
